verdict.rationale: The Convex CLI watches the filesystem. When you change the schema or a function, it pushes the new version to the dev deployment and automatically updates the generated types in convex/_generated (convex-docs-6, convex-docs-17). The product also claims end-to-end type safety (convex-docs-33) on top of its optional schemas (convex-docs-3). Missing for 10: detailed docs on what the generated types and typed client API contain, independent or hands-on corroboration of the codegen workflow.
